Code/technical documentation pattern: a URL example is being shown to illustrate a bug or behavior related to a `?flag` parameter.

The structure "URL with `?flag`" followed by a second URL suggests a comparison or contrast, implying the second URL demonstrates a different or related scenario involving the same `flag` parameter.

Final token `&flag` ends a URL query string (`?a=1&b=2&flag`), strongly constraining the next token to either a closing punctuation, a newline, or continuation of the pattern (e.g., `=true` or a comment referencing the same `flag` behavior mentioned earlier).
"URL: https://example.com/?a=1&b=2&flag" mirrors the earlier `?flag` reference, suggesting the next token completes the parallel structure about the shared parameter.
